name: anıtkabir-pusulası
description: Anıtkabir Pusulası is a compass app that shows the location of Anıtkabir (the mausoleum of Atatürk).

scripts.build-capacitor-ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build-capacitor-android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build-capacitor-ios:beta: npm run build:beta && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build-capacitor-android:beta: npm run build:beta && npx cap sync android
scripts.build-capacitor-ios:development: npm run build:development && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build-capacitor-android:development: npm run build:development && npx cap sync android
scripts.run-android: npm run build-capacitor-android && npx cap run android
scripts.run-ios: npm run build-capacitor-ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.build-android: npm run build-capacitor-android && npx cap build android
scripts.build-ios: npm run build-capacitor-ios && npx cap build ios
